_comment: Crafted (not recorded): the two ways rule_idle_seat fires at ref 2026-07-27, one resource each. seat-idle-1 carries a last_activity_at past the 30d threshold; seat-never-1 carries none and is anchored on created_at instead. Shaped like the GitHub adapter's real output — state null, attached_to 'user:<login>', no tags, no region — but with a generic provider, because the rule is provider-agnostic and a fixture naming GitHub would suggest otherwise. Tag coverage is 0, so the untagged governance rule declines to run and the assertions are about the rule alone.
